sanskrit_verse:
न्यासं कृत्वा परत्रादिं कृत्वा वादिं करोति यः /
विक्रयं वा क्रियां तत्र पश्चिमां बलवत्तराम् ।।
transliteration: nyāsaṃ kṛtvā paratrādiṃ kṛtvā vādiṃ karoti yaḥ / vikrayaṃ vā kriyāṃ tatra paścimāṃ balavattarām //
sph_interpretive_translation: He who, having made a deposit elsewhere, creates a claim or executes a sale in another place, that later transaction shall be deemed authoritative.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from actualization of transactional integrity
Causation is determined by sequential completion of dharmic acts
Capacity-based responsibility arises through conscious enactment of contractual presence
Restoration logic prioritizes final executed will over preliminary arrangements
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of manifest authority at time of execution
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving conflicting claims across jurisdictions, the Supreme Court shall recognize authority based on the location where the final act was consciously enacted and completed, not where preliminary agreements were made.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through manifest action; anupūrvaśaḥ determines that the final executed act carries greater causal weight; proportional responsibility aligns with the locus of conscious completion; no punitive consequence attaches to prior arrangements—only realignment to realized truth.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Confirm temporal and spatial sequence of contractual acts
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Realign parties to acknowledge manifest transaction
Capacity Restoration: Ensure all parties regain clarity on enacted versus intended agreements
Integrity Reintegration: Harmonize records to reflect actualized contractual flow
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Sole Source of Legal Authority: Dharma is restored through recognition of manifest contractual completion; reality is non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
